gloss: grainy bumps; tiny round particles; bumpy texture

definitions.gloss: grainy bumps; tiny round particles; bumpy texture
definitions.explanation: Many small round bumps or grains on or in something — used for textures of food (orange juice with pulp, strawberry seeds, tapioca) and skin (acne, goosebumps, hives).

examples.japanese: イチゴ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つぶつぶ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like the little bumps on strawberries.

examples.japanese: つぶつぶ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦オレンジ→オレンジ：01044_orenji⟧⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought orange juice with pulp in it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}くて→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つぶつぶ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鳥肌|とりはだ}→鳥肌：08544_torihada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: It was so cold that goosebumps came up on my arms.

notes:
Reduplication of ⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧ (grain, particle). Describes the visual or tactile texture of many small round things clustered together. Often appears as つぶつぶ(⟦の→の：09472_no⟧) before a noun, or as a noun on its own meaning 'those little bumps/grains.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- つぶつぶ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧〜: 〜 with bits/pulp in it
- つぶつぶ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧: bumpy/grainy texture
- ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つぶつぶ: bumps on the skin (e.g. acne)
- イチゴ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つぶつぶ: the little seeds on a strawberry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ざらざら→ざらざら：05174_zarazara⟧: rough; gritty — a coarser, more abrasive texture
- ⟦ぶつぶつ→ぶつぶつ：05364_butsubutsu⟧: bigger, more uneven bumps (also rash, pimples); also means muttering
- ぼつぼつ: scattered spots or dots, often used for skin spots
